name: Super LFO
description: Morphing dual-osc LFO with CV form control

sections.heading: Channels
items: Dual oscillators with mix modes and CV destinations for form params

channels.jackDescription: Bipolar or unipolar LFO output per Range param; CV Dest routes external CV to rate, phase, reset, or form targets.
channels.faderDescription: Wave shape continuum on Ch0 Main; duty skew on Ch1 Main.
channels.faderPlusShiftDescription: Level and rate on Alt faders.
channels.fnDescription: Short tap mutes output; Shift cycles CV destination.
